headline: President Biden cancels several earlier presidential orders and makes a small technical fix to another order.
what_it_does: This order revokes, or cancels, certain earlier presidential actions, so those actions no longer have force. It also makes a technical amendment, meaning a minor wording or housekeeping change to an existing order. The title does not say which earlier actions were canceled or what the technical change was.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies would stop carrying out the instructions in the canceled orders and follow the amended wording instead.
